Which animal might I hear making a woof sound?
A dog barks.
If I hear a meow which pet is likely nearby?
A cat meows.
What is the usual noise made by a cow?
A cow moos.
What sort of call might come from a duck?
A duck quacks.
Would you put a frog in the amphibian group?
A frog is an amphibian.
Which group of animals includes butterflies?
A butterfly is an insect.
What group should an elephant be placed in?
An elephant is a mammal.
Would a shark be classified as a fish?
A shark is a fish.
Can you explain why bats are not birds?
No. A bat is a mammal, not a bird.
If penguins cannot fly are they still birds?
A penguin is a bird even though it cannot fly.
Is flight something every bird can do?
No. Penguins and ostriches are birds that cannot fly.
What features make whales mammals instead of fish?
A whale is a mammal. It breathes air and feeds its young milk.
Which animal is called the deadliest because of diseases it spreads?
By human deaths from transmitted diseases, mosquitoes are considered the deadliest animals.
How do mosquitoes cause harm despite their small size?
Some mosquitoes transmit germs that cause diseases such as malaria. That makes them dangerous to people.
Is every mosquito carrying a disease?
Not every mosquito carries disease, and not every bite makes someone sick.
What body part helps an elephant grab things?
Elephants use their trunks to grasp things.
How many legs does a spider have compared with an insect?
A spider is an arachnid with eight legs. An adult insect has six legs.
Hello there, could we discuss animals?
Hello! How are you?
Can we discuss the penguin now?
A penguin is a bird. Penguins cannot fly but are strong swimmers.
What group is it part of?
A penguin is a bird.
Can we discuss the bat now?
A bat is a mammal. Bats are mammals that can fly.
What group is it part of?
A bat is a mammal.
Can we discuss the whale now?
A whale is a mammal. Whales breathe air and feed their young milk.
What group is it part of?
A whale is a mammal.
